lines.text: WoW: Fall Savings (50% off Midnight, 33% off boosts) runs through Nov 2, the Talebound demo opens on the PTR Oct 30 - Nov 1 with no subscription, and Forever's Nov 2 poster signing hands out free tickets from Oct 27

Pokemon GO: GO Pass: November (Groudon, $7.99 Deluxe) is official for Nov 3 - Dec 1 and November Community Day is Pawniard with Kowtow Cleave Kingambit ($1.99 research); the window now reaches Deoxys raids and the Nov 28 Super Mega Raid Day

Aniimo's Oct 29 Part 2 update notice is out: maintenance Oct 28 at 7:00 p.m. (UTC-4) with 500 Glimmer, Windborn Stamps convert to Credits, plus Aniimo Go! from Nov 12, Fantasy Resonance from Nov 20 and the Tidal Treasures login gifts

Ended and dropped: the Forever beta and Stress Test, Minior Orionids, the Max Battle Day, City Safari Boston and the TCG 30th store pickup; the Forever Collector's Edition now shows sold out on the Gear Store

needs_you.action: Early Name Reservation opens today at 1:00 p.m. PDT for Heroic, Epic and Collection buyers and runs through Nov 3; up to three characters across all rulesets, names are first come, first served

Before Part 2 maintenance starts Oct 28 at 7:00 p.m. on the Americas server (UTC-4), claim the last Journey Chronicles login gifts, spend Windborn Stamps (they convert to Credits at 1:2000) and exchange any Harvest Moon Set furniture before it leaves the Home shop
Finish the October Traveler's Log for the Thornshadow Assassin's Attire and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates to November on Nov 1
Buy the $4.99 Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day ticket before sales close Oct 31 at 5pm local if you want up to 14 Raid Passes, Rare Candy XL odds and bonus XP and Stardust
Redeem a Target, GameStop or Best Buy Pokemon GO gift card on the Web Store by Oct 31 to get the Gengar Knit Cap avatar item
Trade pumpkin candy for Pumpkaboo's event furniture at the Pokemon Center before Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises ends Nov 1 at 4:59am local
Watch 4 hours of any World of Warcraft Twitch stream with a linked Battle.net account before Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST to claim the Cuddly Gold-Colored Grrgle housing decor
Fall Savings end Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST: 50% off Midnight, 33% off the Level 80 Character Boost, up to 40% off transmog sets and 30% off game services
Rank up GO Pass: October before rank earning stops Nov 3 at 10am local (GO Points are uncapped Oct 31 - Nov 1); rewards expire Nov 5 at 10am and the Deluxe Lucky Trinket expires Nov 8
Rank up GO Pass: Halloween 2026 before it ends Nov 5 at 8pm local; unlocked rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm
Decide on the Champion of the Wilds Pack (Rexxar's Fabled Attire, Hunter companion toy, Zhevraskin Rug) before it leaves the shop Nov 9 at 10:00 a.m. PST
Friends must redeem an Invite-A-Friend Launch Code on Battle.net by Nov 11; launch-week access ends then and a subscription or Game Time is needed from Nov 12

Buy the $11.99 GO Wild Area: Global ticket on the Web Store before the event opens Nov 14 at 10am local if you want the Gigantamax Duraludon Special Research, mighty Latias and Latios on Incense and the Shiny boost
Claim GO Pass: Into the Wild rewards by Nov 17 at 11:59pm local (rank earning stops Nov 15 at 6pm); the Deluxe Silver Bottle Cap expires Nov 22 at 11:59pm whether or not you claimed it
Finish and claim the TCG 30th Celebration Timed Research by Nov 20 at 10pm local or its rewards are lost
Evolve Bisharp by Nov 21 at 9pm local for a Kingambit with Kowtow Cleave; during the window the evolution only needs one Dark- or Steel-type raid boss defeated
Rank up GO Pass: November before rank earning stops Dec 1 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points Nov 28-29; unlocked rewards expire Dec 3 at 10am

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts holiday and shop news about a week ahead; the Trading Post lineup lands in the last days of the prior month.

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: The Labyrinth, Ascendant Venomstones and Midnight Season 2 are live; 12.1.7 is on the PTR with no date.

timeline.title: Hallow's End
timeline.detail: Candy buckets across Quel'Thalas, Hallow's End haunts in your neighborhood, new holiday decor and achievements through Nov 2.

timeline.title: Twitch Drop: Cuddly Gold-Colored Grrgle decor
timeline.detail: Watch 4 hours of any WoW stream with linked accounts before Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST; claimed copies unlock vendor repurchases.

timeline.title: Trading Post: October's Costumed Calamity stock
timeline.detail: Fill the Traveler's Log for the Thornshadow Assassin's Attire and spend or freeze Tender before the Nov 1 rotation.

timeline.title: Fall Savings sale
timeline.detail: 50% off Midnight, 33% off the Level 80 boost, up to 40% off transmogs and 30% off services until Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST.

timeline.title: Champion of the Wilds Pack (Rexxar)
timeline.detail: Rexxar's Fabled Attire, the Misha and Huffer pet toy and a Zhevraskin Rug leave the shop Nov 9 at 10:00 a.m. PST.

timeline.title: 12-Month Subscription bonus items
timeline.detail: Ashen Dreadglider and Giant Grrloc mounts plus Forever-only tabard, backpack and Azurky pet; redeem by Apr 30, 2027.

timeline.title: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking
timeline.detail: Run Timewalking dungeons for the weekly quest before reset on Nov 3.

timeline.title: Talebound demo on the PTR
timeline.detail: Try Red Hollow and three tales as Slayer, Inquisitor or Witch on the 12.1.7 PTR; no subscription needed.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (November)
timeline.detail: Darkmoon Island opens for the month's profession quests, Darkmoon Prize Tickets and the carousel buff.

timeline.title: Day of the Dead
timeline.detail: Visit any graveyard for the Macabre Marionette pet and holiday cooking.

timeline.title: Midnight Dungeon Event
timeline.detail: Bonus event week with the Midnight dungeon weekly quest.

timeline.title: Moonkin Festival (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Two-day moonkin micro-holiday in Moonglade.

timeline.title: WoW's 22nd Anniversary
timeline.detail: Wowhead's calendar lists the anniversary event from Nov 17; Blizzard has not posted this year's rewards yet.

timeline.title: Legion Timewalking
timeline.detail: Legion Timewalking week, including the Mage Tower.

timeline.title: Pilgrim's Bounty
timeline.detail: Cook the feast tables and finish the Pilgrim's Bounty achievements by Nov 29.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Oct 27 (now): Warlords of Draenor Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Hallow's End through Nov 2; Talebound PTR demo Oct 30 - Nov 1; Trading Post rotates Nov 1 (Blizzard has not posted November's lineup; Icy Veins' datamined theme is "Food, Glorious Food"); Darkmoon Faire Nov 1-7; Day of the Dead Nov 1-3

Week of Nov 3: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble; the Grrgle Twitch drop and Fall Savings both end Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST; WoW: Forever launches Nov 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST; the Rexxar pack leaves the shop Nov 9 at 10:00 a.m. PST
Week of Nov 10: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Moonkin Festival Nov 12-13
Week of Nov 17: WoW's 22nd Anniversary begins (through Dec 8 on Wowhead's calendar, no Blizzard post yet); Legion Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu; Pilgrim's Bounty from Nov 22
Week of Nov 24: World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Southshore vs. Tarren Mill; Pilgrim's Bounty through Nov 29; Trading Post rotates to December on Dec 1
Dec 1 (window end): Pet Battle Bonus Event (Wowhead's calendar also lists a Battleground Bonus Event that week) and PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran begin at reset
12.1.7 Echoes of the Worldcore (Return to Dornogal campaign, Talebound, Lorewalking, Turbulent Timeways VI) is on the PTR with no release date; Blizzard Watch's estimate is Dec 8
just_past_window: Dec 7-8: Wanderer's Festival micro-holiday; Dec 8: the 22nd Anniversary ends and Battle for Azeroth Timewalking plus PvP Brawl: Packed House begin
Dec 8: Blizzard Watch's estimated 12.1.7 release date; Blizzard has not announced one
Dec 15: Feast of Winter Veil begins (through Jan 2) with the Delves Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Deep Six

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts Forever dates in news posts and blue posts, usually a week or two ahead.

timeline.title: Early Name Reservation
timeline.detail: Upgrade buyers can create up to three characters from Oct 27 at 1:00 p.m. PDT; names are first come, first served.

timeline.title: Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes
timeline.detail: Codes from Heroic (1) and Epic or Collection (3) purchases let a friend play launch week Nov 4-11 without a subscription.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever poster signing with the devs
timeline.detail: Free, limited tickets go up on TIXR Oct 27 at 12:00 p.m. PDT; entry needs a timed QR code.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever launches
timeline.detail: Included with any WoW subscription or Game Time; pick Normal, PvP, Roleplaying or Roleplay-PvP, Hardcore comes later.

timeline.title: Pre-purchase upgrades: Heroic $29.99, Epic $59.99, Collection $79.99
timeline.detail: Heroic adds the Skyborne race and name reservation; Epic adds 30 days of Game Time; the Collection is sold through Jan 11, 2027.

timeline.title: Collector's Edition
timeline.detail: The restock shows sold out on the Gear Store; restock orders ship February 2027 with the Collection digital code.

weekly_rhythm: Name Reservation: three characters total across all rulesets, two-part names, first come first served; the Roleplay-PvP ruleset is available at reservation and at launch (Oct 22 update); Hardcore arrives "sometime after launch" (Blizzard) or winter 2026 (Wowhead's roadmap)

Launch Nov 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST is included with any subscription or Game Time; Epic Pack and Collection buyers get 30 days of Game Time from Nov 4; Invite-A-Friend guests lose access after Nov 11; the beta closed Oct 23
Rulesets are separate ecosystems with no cross-ruleset grouping; a PvP-ruleset account can only create characters for one faction; Battlegrounds mix rulesets except Hardcore
Raids: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40, Drakefire Amulet attunement) unlock Dec 9, so start the attunement chain as soon as you hit 60

12-month subscription or 365-day Game Time bonuses include the Forever-only Tabard of Eternal Exploration, Eternal Explorer's Backpack and Azurky pet; they arrive by Oct 31 and must be redeemed by Apr 30, 2027
Blizzard has not said whether Hallow's End or Pilgrim's Bounty run in Forever; the dev podcast continues through launch
just_past_window: Dec 9: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open (Blizzard-confirmed)
Hardcore ruleset: "sometime after launch" per Blizzard, winter 2026 per Wowhead

games.typical_lead_time: Niantic posts most events 1-3 weeks ahead; Spotlight and Raid Hours appear with the monthly roundup.

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Season ends Dec 1 at 10am local; the next season is not announced.

timeline.title: GO Pass: October
timeline.detail: Kyogre encounter on the free track; rank earning stops Nov 3 at 10am, rewards expire Nov 5, Lucky Trinket expires Nov 8.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part I
timeline.detail: Costumed Pikachu, Zubat and Sinistea debut; tap spooky surprises in the wild for Candy; free Timed Research expires Nov 1 at 10am.

timeline.title: GO Pass: Halloween 2026
timeline.detail: Rank 10 unlocks 2x catch Candy and Rank 20 2x catch Stardust (3x on Deluxe); rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm.

timeline.title: adidas | Pokemon Timed Research
timeline.detail: Free Timed Research for the adidas avatar items runs until Jan 15.

timeline.title: Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Chandelure debuts with Super Max level; six free passes from Gyms, Remote Raid limit 20; the $4.99 ticket sells until 5pm.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part II
timeline.detail: Shiny Greavard debuts, Mega Sableye gains Super Max and Night Shade+; free Timed Research expires Nov 5 at 8pm.

timeline.title: GO Pass: November
timeline.detail: Groudon encounter and 400 PokeCoins on the free track (1,400 on Deluxe); GO Points are uncapped Nov 28-29; rewards expire Dec 3.

timeline.title: Into the Wild
timeline.detail: Dynamax Regidrago and Meltan debut, Crowned Zacian and Zamazenta raids; GO Pass: Into the Wild runs to Nov 15 with a $14.99 Deluxe.

timeline.title: Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026: Global
timeline.detail: Gigantamax Duraludon debuts, Dynamax Dialga Sat and Palkia Sun, Kyurem fusion raids and GO Safari Balls; the $11.99 ticket adds Special Research.

timeline.title: Minior Showers: Leonids
timeline.detail: A new Minior core color debuts; shooting stars and boosted Minior spawns 5-9pm local each day.

timeline.title: Dynamax Trails
timeline.detail: Listed on Leek Duck's calendar with no official post yet; details to come.

timeline.title: November Community Day: Pawniard
timeline.detail: Evolve Bisharp by 9pm for Kingambit with Kowtow Cleave; 1/4 hatch distance and 2x catch Candy; $1.99 Special Research.

timeline.title: Twilight Wishes
timeline.detail: Season-closing event on Leek Duck's calendar with no official post yet.

timeline.title: Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: On Leek Duck's calendar; the featured Mega and ticket are not announced.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday Max Battles run 6am-9pm local; Daily Discoveries pause Nov 9-15
Spotlight Hours: Gastly Oct 29 (2x evolve XP); witch-hat Teddiursa Nov 5 (2x evolve XP); Nov 12 and Nov 19 not posted; Noibat Nov 26 (2x catch Candy)

Max Mondays: Machop Nov 2; Into the Wild Max Battles Nov 11 Registeel, Nov 12 Regidrago, Nov 13 Latias and Latios (each with a 6-7pm hour); Dynamax Dialga Nov 14 and Palkia Nov 15 with Gigantamax Duraludon at Wild Area Global; Nov 16 TBA; Espurr Nov 23; Cryogonal Nov 30

5-star raids: Giratina (Origin) Oct 28 - Nov 3; Giratina (Altered) Nov 4-8; Crowned Zacian and Zamazenta Nov 9-13; Zekrom and White Kyurem Nov 14, Reshiram and Black Kyurem Nov 15; Cresselia and Darkrai Nov 16-24; Deoxys (all four formes) Nov 25 - Dec 1
Raid Hours: Giratina (Origin) Oct 28; Giratina (Altered) Nov 4; Zacian Mon Nov 9 and Zamazenta Tue Nov 10; Cresselia and Darkrai Nov 18; Deoxys Nov 25

Mega Raids: Sableye Oct 28 - Nov 8 (Super Max from Nov 1); none listed Nov 9-15; Banette Nov 16-24; Metagross Nov 25 - Dec 1; weekend Shadow Raids: Shadow Landorus through Nov 3, Shadow Tornadus Nov 4-8 and Nov 16 - Dec 1

GO Battle League (rotates Tuesdays 1pm PT): Master and Mega Halloween Cup Oct 27 - Nov 3; Mega Editions of all three leagues Nov 3-10; Great, Ultra Mega and 2026 GO LAIC Cup Nov 10-17; Ultra, Master Mega and LAIC Cup Nov 17-24; Master and Mega Catch Cup Nov 24 - Dec 1

Mega Chandelure Global Challenge runs Oct 30 5:00 p.m. to Oct 31 8:00 p.m. PDT and pays out Nov 2-15; Remote Raid limit is 20 for the raid day, 30 during Into the Wild and unlimited Nov 14-15; Shiny Meltan and Shiny Gimmighoul chances Nov 9-15
Non-US: Wild Area 2026 in Sendai and Mexico City Nov 6-8; Pokemon Night Out at The O2 (London) Nov 10 for attendees; Pokemon GO Tour: Alola is Feb 19-21 (LA, Kaohsiung) and Feb 27-28 (global) 2027
just_past_window: Dec 1: Twilight Trails ends at 10am local after the Master League and Mega Catch Cup week; the next season is not announced; GO Pass: November rewards expire Dec 3
Dec 11-16: Minior Showers: Geminids, with a different core debuting in each hemisphere

games.typical_lead_time: The Pokemon Company announces Pokopia events 2-3 weeks ahead on pokemon.com; DLC dates arrive in Pokemon Presents or news posts.

timeline.title: Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises
timeline.detail: Use Camouflage to startle Pokemon for pumpkin candy and trade it at the Pokemon Center before Nov 1 at 4:59am local.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the launch-commemoration Ditto Rug via Mystery Gift (Internet) before Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now, Part 2 late 2026, Part 3 in 2027
timeline.detail: Buy by Aug 31, 2027 for the 30 rare Pokemetal ingots code; Part 2 adds accessories, furniture and Pokemon, Part 3 a new town.

weekly_rhythm: Version 2.0.0 (Aug 5) is still the current build on Serebii's patch list: Dive, Bubbly Basin, the portal pod and bulk storage moves; no newer patch has shipped or been announced
No November event is announced yet; Pumpkaboo was announced Sep 30 for an Oct 17 start, so a late-November event would normally surface in early November
No Mystery Gift codes are active for US players; the Ditto Rug internet gift is the only live distribution
Expansion Pass Part 2 is dated "late 2026" with no new town; Part 3 with a new town is dated 2027; the Pokemetal ingots code is valid through Sep 30, 2027
just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 is still only dated "late 2026": accessories, new furniture and Pokemon, no new town

games.typical_lead_time: Pawprint posts update notices on aniimo.com about two days before maintenance and previews about two weeks out.

timeline.title: Part 2 maintenance closes Part I
timeline.detail: Americas servers go down Oct 28 at 7:00 p.m. (UTC-4); 500 Glimmer compensation, Windborn Stamps convert to Credits at 1:2000.

timeline.title: Windchaser's Departure: Irisalis
timeline.detail: Craft the Legendary Aniipod: Irisalis from Iris Petals, then the 100%-catch Windchaser's Departure Aniipod, before Dec 9 at 7:59 p.m. (UTC-4).

timeline.title: Journey Chronicles login event
timeline.detail: Claim the remaining login gifts, including the day-7 Sparkling Egg, before maintenance on Oct 28.

timeline.title: Season 1 Part 2: Whisperwake Isles
timeline.detail: 51 new Aniimo, four Whisperwake regions, Trailblazer II and III caps to 70, Hypnyto Companion Handbook and Prismana Ekrim achievement.

timeline.title: Night Parade (Halloween)
timeline.detail: Earn Halloween Candy from Daily Activity to light the Candy House for an Avatar Frame and Sparkling Crystal; ends Dec 10 at 3:59 a.m. (UTC-4).

timeline.title: Tidal Treasures login check-in
timeline.detail: 14 cumulative login days pay a Sparkling Cube, Sparkling Crystal, Sparkling Egg and Aniipod Ultra.

timeline.title: Companion Handbook: Hypnyto
timeline.detail: Free track gives a Hypnyto Egg and a random Perfect egg; the paid Advanced edition adds a Perfect Prismana Hypnyto; closes Dec 9 at 7:59 p.m. (UTC-4).

timeline.title: Vein Abundance: Part 2 Prismana weeks
timeline.detail: Weekly nurture boosts plus Pouchwisp, Royalby, Jeburst and Glameep Prismana weeks, all four at once Nov 30 - Dec 6.

timeline.title: Aniimo Go! racing
timeline.detail: Open-world racing from Nov 12 at 10:00 server time; three tracks, one opening every two weeks, for an Avatar Frame.

timeline.title: Prismana Photo
timeline.detail: Snap five Sparkling types of each phase's Prismana (Nov 12-15, Nov 16-22, Nov 23-29) for rewards.

timeline.title: Fantasy Resonance: Jaguaraun
timeline.detail: Quests for the first player co-created Aniimo unlock Jaguaraun's exclusive offering recipe.

weekly_rhythm: Part 2 maintenance: Americas Oct 28 7:00 p.m. to Oct 29 3:00 a.m. (UTC-4), 500 Glimmer compensation; the console dev post calls the update Version 1.1; Windborn Stamps convert to Credits at 1:2000 and the Harvest Moon Set leaves the Home shop as the Magical Wonder Night season begins

Holo-Battle Interlink runs Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 server time; after the update its three paths are rated separately and star rewards must be claimed manually; Hatch Haste halves egg timers Friday to Sunday (tracker)

Vein Abundance Prismana weeks (server time): Pouchwisp Nov 2-8 (Rosy Mirelands / Tideblossom Coast); Royalby Nov 9-15 (Wildwater Gorge / Sea of Flowers); Jeburst Nov 16-22 (Cloudreach Falls / Russet Highlands); Glameep Nov 23-29 (Crescent Bay / Echoback Landing); all four Nov 30 - Dec 6

Rotating events: Who's That Aniimo? and Idyll Ecological Investigation Oct 30 - Nov 5, Nov 13-19 and Nov 27 - Dec 3; Glamour Star Nov 6-12, Nov 20-26 and Dec 4-10; Prismana Photo phases Nov 12-15, Nov 16-22 and Nov 23-29

Also new in Part 2: Operation: Egg Heist 3-team PVP test daily 18:00-24:00 (level 50), 4v4 Spar duels, Sparkling Hue swaps, Home RV three-story builds; shop sets Gorgeous Night Owl, Nightshadow Dash and the Mystic Night Encounter pumpkin head (prices not posted)
just_past_window: Dec 4-10: last Glamour Star round and the final Who's That Aniimo? phase (Nov 27 - Dec 3)
Dec 9 at 7:59 p.m. (UTC-4): Part 2, Irisalis and the Hypnyto Companion Handbook close; Dec 10 at 3:59 a.m.: Night Parade, Tidal Treasures, Aniimo Go! and the Home season end
